summary: This class explains the liturgical customs for reading the Parashiyot of Nissabim, Vayelekh, and Haazinu depending on the calendar year. It details the specific makamat used for these portions and their associated haftarot, as well as the customs for Shabbat Teshuvah and the reading of Haazinu after Yom Kippur.
questions: What makam is used for Nissabim and Vayelekh when read together before Rosh Hashanah?
How does the choice of makam change if Vayelekh is read on Shabbat Teshuvah?
What is the custom for the prayer tunes on the Motza'ei Shabbat of Shabbat Teshuvah?
What is the haftarah for Haazinu when it falls after Yom Kippur?
Do the reading breaks for Haazinu apply on weekdays?
